#### problem_chain

- **Root.** The customer raises only the $15.00 monthly maintenance fee (ac3b877d, posted 2026-08-28, the cycle closing date, since `statement_cycle_day` is 28). Policy 3 governs it.
- **Conditions policy 3 imposes before judging:** "every credit the bank already owes on the account is posted first". Owed credits in this world:
  - **N1: refund of the most recent transfer fee** 33f98086 ($10.00, 2026-08-19), under policy 1. The fee's source item is transfer 1513ef68, whose counterparty is 4ba33c1d (Goal Builder, ineligible), so it is a bank error. Unmet at the opening: no `checking_fee_refund` row has `source_item_id = 33f98086`. Kind: value_input into `own_part`.
  - **N0: refund of the earlier transfer fee** df93130c ($10.00, 2026-07-20), under base `checking_evt_fee_refund`. Transfer fe01c547, counterparty 4ba33c1d, ineligible. Unmet: no refund row with that source. Kind: value_input into `own_part`. It is bundled into the declared edge 3→1, whose condition reads "Every overdraft transfer fee charged in error".
  - **N2: provisional credit on dispute 01d51833**, under policy 2. Status `submitted`; exactly 1 submitted dispute; due since 08-24. Unmet: no `checking_provisional_credit` row carries this dispute id. Kind: value_input into `own_part`.
  - Sub-conditions: policies 1 and 2 declare `[]`. Walking their rules against this world finds no further unmet condition.
- **Derived tree.** Root → {N0, N1, N2}, all value_input, no cycle. Topological order: {N0, N1, N2} in any order, then the root. It has 3 prerequisite nodes, which is ≥ 2, and they are grouped under 2 declared edges. That is isomorphic to the declared tree (3→1 with the base-ground refund folded into its condition, and 3→2).
- **Load-bearing runs.** Relationship = max(0, ledger) + savings 2847.30 + certificate 10212.64; mortgage is excluded because Interest Checking has `relationship_balance_includes_mortgage: false`; threshold 15000.00.

  | run | ledger | relationship | refund |

  | all three credits posted | 1949.36 | 15009.30 | 15.00 |
  | skip N1 | 1939.36 | 14999.30 | 0 |
  | skip N0 | 1939.36 | 14999.30 | 0 |
  | skip N2 | 1463.16 | 14523.10 | 0 |

  Every node bears weight.
- **Parallel edges.** N0, N1 and N2 share no cap, no dedup key and no balance read. Each only adds its own amount. Any order gives the same terminal state.
- **Tools do not judge prerequisites.** The bodies of `refund_transfer_fee_error_033d9cbf`, `post_dispute_provisional_credit_5453b90d` and `refund_same_day_maintenance_fee_e9518b99` (task_tools.py lines 40–55, 82–94, 121–133) create the row and update the balance with no condition or check.
- **Persona.** It raises only the fee. It names no transfer fee and no dispute. The dispute is confirmed only "when the representative names a specific claim … about a car-loan payment", a general question gets "you are only calling about the fee today", and she gives "yes, please do" when the agent asks to proceed with a correction the bank owes. She volunteers no prerequisite and names no extra work item. Her arc closes on "Once they tell you the $15.00 has been refunded … say goodbye", which is the last gold-shaped action.
